article.story: New Mexico (8-2) at Wyoming (7-3), Nov. 20 at 9 p.m. EST. Opening Line: New Mexico by 7.5. Against the spread: New Mexico 7-3, Wyoming 6-4. How to watch: Fox Sports 1 Key stats New Mexico Offense Overall: 357.1 yards per game (89th in FBS) Passing: 145 yards per game (132nd) Rushing: 212.1 yards per game (14th) Scoring: 32.8 points per game (31st) New Mexico Defense Overall: 248.9 yards per game (2nd in FBS) Passing: 172.7 yards per game (12th) Rushing: 76.2 yards per game (3rd) Scoring: 11.9 points per game (2nd) Wyoming Offense Overall: 355.9 yards per game (91st in FBS) Passing: 156.2 yards per game (130th) Rushing: 199.7 yards per game (23rd) Scoring: 22.4 points per game (105th) Wyoming Defense Overall: 356.1 yards per game (67th in FBS) Passing: 167.1 yards per game (11th) Rushing: 189 yards per game (119th) Scoring: 21 points per game (37th) Wyoming is 125th in third down percentage, converting 32.1% of the time. New Mexico ranks 18th on defense, allowing its opponents at convert at 31.6%. Wyoming ranks 116th in the FBS with a -6 turnover margin, compared to New Mexico's 1st-ranked +19 margin. Wyoming ranks 20th in the FBS averaging 43.2 penalty yards per game. New Mexico is 70th in FBS in red zone offense, scoring on 84.6% of trips. Wyoming's red zone defense ranks 18th at 74.3%. Wyoming ranks 71st in the FBS with an average time of possession of 30:05, compared to New Mexico's 5th-ranked average of 33:38. Team leaders New Mexico Passing: Toa Fa'avae, 1,081 yards, 8 TDs, 8 INTs, 58.5 completion percentage Rushing: Scottre Humphrey, 736 yards on 147 carries, 14 TDs Receiving: Cade Keith, 384 yards on 30 catches, 5 TDs Wyoming Passing: Tyler Hughes, 1,238 yards, 6 TDs, 7 INTs, 62.1 completion percentage Rushing: Hughes, 687 yards on 113 carries, 6 TDs Receiving: Kyle Frendt, 356 yards on 17 catches, 2 TDs Last game New Mexico fell 21-17 to UNLV on Nov. 14. Bailen George threw for 65 yards on 1-of-1 attempts (100.0%) with no touchdowns and no interceptions. Humphrey had 89 rushing yards on 19 carries and one touchdown. D.J. Darling had one reception for 65 yards. Wyoming defeated UTEP 27-15 on Nov. 14. Landon Sims passed for 289 yards on 19-of-25 attempts (76.0%) with one touchdown and no interceptions. He also carried the ball seven times for 29 yards. Samuel Harris carried the ball 10 times for 66 yards and scored one touchdown, adding four receptions for 82 yards and one touchdown. Frendt recorded 113 yards on four catches. Next game New Mexico hosts Air Force on Nov. 27. Wyoming hosts UConn on Nov. 28.
